'''2008 Worlds Day 2 John Veasey DS Let Them Make The First Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Veasey]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Sheet title Will it Work? Podrace + duelists package.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[John Veasey]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge|Let Them Make The First Move]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
